title: Unknown sender to the King (Francis I), BnF fr. 3029 ff. 134-135, no. 59 (DECODE R3670)

steps.what: Repo grep: fr3029/ (catalogue 174) had closed the fr. 3029 ciphers as 'broken by Lasry' without reading any leaf; f.134 not covered. Tomokiyo's GL.htm (gramont1529/GL.htm) lists f.134 no.59 'au roy' under the fr. 3029 cipher; key image fetched.
Gallica SRU dc.source 'Français 3029' gave btv1b90598719; canvases unlabelled, so contact strips (views 182-218) located f.134r = view 210, f.135r = 211, address = 213.
30 cipher lines transcribed by eye from line-band crops, each sign written as its key letter (transcription.txt).
Lasry's table applied unchanged: French reads at once ('avoir par l'amiable les veult recouvrer par les armes').
Blotted sign at 134r22 end and the doubtful 'l.lis', 'diort', '?icy' re-cropped at full resolution; blot read as C (car|dinal).
lang.lm.best_language on the letters: fr-1600-letters first (-2.00 vs fr-modern -2.20, la -2.69).

Whole letter read: war to recover costs against the lands of the Church under the defensive league; Venetian ambassador; Toledo given to the bishop of Palencia with pensions to the cardinals de' Medici and 'd'Iort' and the new cardinal Carafa; bishop of Badajoz leaves; rumour of poisoning ‹N2›.

outcome.notes: All 30 cipher lines read with Lasry's key unchanged; 9 name/place signs open; one proper name (L.lis) unidentified; date not fixed.

gaps.item: name signs N1-N4 and place sign P1 (9 tokens)
gaps.detail: unidentified in Lasry's table too; only the sibling fr. 3029 / fr. 3092 letters could fix them

outcome.fraction_read_source: fr3029f134/signs.txt: 984 signs, 9 name/place signs without a value = 975/984

prior.where: Lasry key table (05/11/2023) on Tomokiyo's cryptiana GL.htm (section 'De la Tremoille's(?) Cipher'); no plaintext of f.134 published there or on DECODE

human: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the problem with /goal (the DECODE R3670 catalogue card). No target-specific intervention recorded.
